args.purpose: Check delivered orders with 1-star reviews and late delivery
args.sql:
WITH order_reviews_1 AS (
    SELECT order_id, MIN(review_score) as min_score, MAX(review_score) as max_score, COUNT(*) as review_count
    FROM order_reviews
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_delivered_1star_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN o.order_id END) as late_delivered_1star_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) as pct_late
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND r.review_score = 1

args.purpose: Check review score distribution when multiple reviews exist per order
args.sql:
WITH order_score_summary AS (
    SELECT order_id, 
           COUNT(*) as num_reviews,
           COUNT(DISTINCT review_score) as num_distinct_scores,
           MIN(review_score) as min_score,
           MAX(review_score) as max_score
    FROM order_reviews
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT num_reviews, num_distinct_scores, count(*) 
FROM order_score_summary
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2;

args.purpose: Compare DISTINCT order_id with EXISTS for delivered orders receiving a 1-star review
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders_join,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN o.order_id END) as late_orders_join,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) as pct_late_join,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) 
     FROM orders o2 
     WHERE o2.order_status = 'delivered' 
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id = o2.order_id AND r.review_score = 1)) as total_orders_exists,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) 
     FROM orders o2 
     WHERE o2.order_status = 'delivered' 
       AND o2.order_delivered_customer_date > o2.order_estimated_delivery_date
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id = o2.order_id AND r.review_score = 1)) as late_orders_exists
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND r.review_score = 1

args.purpose: Check delivery date status for delivered orders with 1-star review
args.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as null_delivery_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as late,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 end) as on_time
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.review_score = 1)
